theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks is the only theme combining the absolute-trend gate (eligible=true) with the strongest durability_bar (0.69) and highest breadth (0.769), while also being the confirmed rotation leader with a large margin over the challenger.
